description: Golden reference for PEEC-inductance on a 3-turn loft coil (multi-turn, tight pancake) with explicit lead bars.
rationale: Locks in the cross-section-centroid chain method PLUS lead-bar-aware chain augmentation for loft-of-profiles solids whose terminal leads are straight cylindrical bars (CYLINDER faces, no intermediate CIRCLE samples).  Kubota's 3turncoil geometry has 2 lead bars at y=+/-12.5mm extending 60-61mm in +/-X from the helix end to the lead terminal.  Pre-2026-05-13 the NN-chain saw only the lead cap CIRCLE edges (no body samples), giving a chain like: lead_inner_cap_A -> [helix 314 segs] -> lead_inner_cap_B -> lead_outer_cap_B (61mm single seg) -> lead_outer_cap_A (25mm fake U-bend through air).  This produced L = 421.84 nH (-1.04% vs analytic 426.25 nH).  The 421.84 nH happened to be near analytic because the missing lead B body under-prediction + the fake 25mm air-jump over-prediction approximately cancelled.  Since 4.44.0 the chain is augmented after NN-chain by _augment_chain_with_lead_bars: long segs on a lead axis are subdivided into N intermediate stations; fake air-jumps at chain ends are dropped; missing lead bodies are prepended/appended.  Result: L = 426.30 nH (+0.02% vs analytic 426.25 nH, on both the in-repo 3turnCoil_work_coil.step and W:/kubota/3turncoil.stp).  The chain now correctly starts at one lead's outer tip (port +) and ends at the other lead's outer tip (port -).

sample.comment: File lives on Kubota's 100号機 share (W:) not in-repo (4 MB).  Test skips if unavailable rather than duplicating the binary in the repo.  Coordinates in metres (CLAUDE.md m-only policy).  The in-repo sibling src/radia/panels/samples/3turnCoil_work_coil.step has the same physical geometry and produces the same L (verified 2026-05-13).

physics.coil: 3-turn pancake coil R_avg~35mm r_wire=3.15mm, 2 lead bars 60-61mm at y=+/-12.5mm

regression_guard.comment: Hard band centred on analytic 426.25 nH (+/-3%).  Historical baselines: 2026-04-21 longest-edge gave L=4.78 nH; GeomType string compare missed enum; NN chain without tangent continuity doubled path length.  2026-04-28 (4.14.0): _collect_circle_edge_centers recovered cross-section centroids from semicircle pairs of a UNITE'd STEP.  2026-05-13 (4.44.0): _augment_chain_with_lead_bars repairs lead-related NN-chain artifacts (single-seg lead bodies, fake U-bends, missing lead bodies) -- the 421.84 nH plateau was a topology bug masquerading as accuracy.
